PDF Interactive Editing of Voxel-Based Signed Distance Fields
Such fusion approaches result in Truncated Signed Distance Field (TSDF) volumes that contain distance values only in vicinity to the geometry's surface. Apart from automatic reconstruction from scan data, voxel-based SDFs can also be created from polygonal meshes or point clouds using distance transform algorithms.
